summary: I deleted the old outputs and rebuilt all three documents with make doc. They reproduced the author proofs byte for byte: the study is 34 pages (5dd437b0...821b), the concise study 12 pages (ea145b8e...a161) and the homily 3 pages (62a1014c...4bb7). No source or layout edit was made. I recorded the snapshot in research/artifacts.json (sha256 ca2b4f83...39f5), put the rasters under build/tpt-runs/71b6f89518984232/artifacts/build-artifacts-0000/rasters and added a Build-artifacts section to research/production-review.md. It flags study pages 22 and 29, short section ends, for the visual reviewer.
